name: Baharijodon
isnote: Named as a goniopholidid by Kuhn (1936); Buffetaut and Taquet (1979) referred the tooth to the Trematochampsidae (English Wikipedia).
sum: Baharijodon is a crocodylomorph known only from a single tooth from the Cenomanian Bahariya Formation of Egypt.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A single tooth figured by Stromer in 1933, from the Bahariya Formation, Egypt; Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
biology: Known from one tooth; the sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Kuhn 1936

sources.text: R. L. Carroll. 1988. Vertebrate Paleontology and Evolution.
